part.text:
Fixed. The change is in `lucene/core/src/java/org/apache/lucene/index/SegmentInfos.java:1027` — `replace(SegmentInfos other)` now copies `other.userData` in addition to the segments and `lastGeneration`.

This matters because `IndexWriter` (IndexWriter.java:1101) calls `segmentInfos.replace(oldInfos)` when opening from an explicit commit point, so the writer's live `SegmentInfos` previously lost the commit's user data.
